visual.name: pnlByDatenWG
visual.description: IBCS-inspired P&L / GuV statement: unbalanced parent-child account hierarchy from a dimension table, subtotal and formula rows (EBITDA, margins), sign conventions with variance-invert for cost rows, scenarios AC/PY/PL/FC with delta bars and delta-percent pins against a selectable reference, expand/collapse with persisted state, k/m scaling and a 3-line IBCS title block. Four views: table, structure bars, row waterfall and a value driver tree that grows either from the formula graph (DuPont) or from a plain dimension hierarchy, with card zoom, re-root and breadcrumb. Clicking a row or card sets the Power BI selection (cross-filtering and native drillthrough), a right click opens the host context menu, and the tile view carries a drill button that does both in one gesture.

dataRoles.name: account
dataRoles.description: Unique, stable account key from the account dimension

dataRoles.name: levels
dataRoles.description: Star-schema alternative to Parent ID: flattened hierarchy levels in drag order. Ragged branches end at an empty level or when a level repeats the previous one.

dataRoles.name: parent
dataRoles.description: Parent-child link; unbalanced hierarchies are allowed

dataRoles.name: displayInvert
dataRoles.description: Show positive although the calculated value is negative

dataRoles.name: varianceInvert
dataRoles.description: Flip variance color (costs below plan = green)

dataRoles.name: period
dataRoles.description: Month column for sparklines and YTD aggregation; values are summed across the shown periods. Date keys (YYYY-MM, YYYY-MM-DD), date columns and month names (Dez, Dezember, Dec, March, Mär …) are read into calendar order automatically — see Columns → Period sort order for fiscal years

dataRoles.name: comment
dataRoles.description: Comment text per row — shown as numbered marker with a footnote section

dataRoles.name: fcFy
dataRoles.description: Full-year forecast scalar (repeated per month row; first value wins, never summed)

dataRoles.name: plFy
dataRoles.description: Full-year plan scalar for the outlook block
